reject.coroot/coroot: APM product, not a log collection pipeline
reject.agronholm/apscheduler: scheduler without a distributed task queue
reject.lfnovo/open-notebook: research assistant, not a general note-taking application
reject.BrowserMCP/mcp: browser automation server, not a browser extension

static_site_generators.comparison_rule: Compare publication/build needs; do not assume every framework is static-only.

code_editors.comparison_rule: Platform and interface differences must be conditions, not assumed shared features.

package_managers.comparison_rule: Ask about language or operating-system fit; cross-ecosystem projects are not drop-in substitutes.

game_engines.comparison_rule: Keep target language, runtime, and deployment platform explicit.

backup_tools.comparison_rule: Specify workload (files, database, Kubernetes, game saves); do not invent shared database features.

build_systems.comparison_rule: Specify language and monorepo or single-project scope.

message_brokers.comparison_rule: Specify protocol and deployment conditions; never assume AMQP and MQTT are interchangeable.

api_gateways.comparison_rule: Distinguish gateway runtime, framework integration, and protocol support.

ocr_tools.comparison_rule: Specify document type, language, runtime, and whether extraction or searchable-PDF output is needed.

javascript_testing.comparison_rule: Distinguish unit testing from browser end-to-end testing.

search_cli.comparison_rule: Distinguish text, structural, filename, and fuzzy search; do not assume identical search semantics.

database_clients.comparison_rule: Specify database engine, desktop/browser/terminal environment, and query workflow.

serverless_platforms.comparison_rule: Distinguish hosting platform from its CLI or framework; ask about deployment fit.

log_collectors.comparison_rule: Specify logs, metrics, traces, processing, and sink requirements separately.

reverse_proxies.comparison_rule: Specify HTTP/TCP, service discovery, configuration model, and edge deployment.

task_queues.comparison_rule: Specify runtime and broker/storage constraints; scheduling alone is not queueing.

geospatial_tools.comparison_rule: Distinguish visualization, spatial analysis, routing, and geofencing.

localization_tools.comparison_rule: Specify framework and whether translation, message formatting, or asset generation is needed.

note_apps.comparison_rule: Specify local, self-hosted, collaboration, and encryption requirements.

home_automation.comparison_rule: Distinguish controller, camera analysis, energy charging, and device integration.

browser_extensions.comparison_rule: Distinguish end-user extension from extension framework and browser automation server.
